intake.visible_note: 系统提示本期还款次日到期。客户已同意通过模拟电话接收提醒，并接受站内通知。需在 24 小时内核实权威账务状态。

contact_policy.content: State the verified status and support options. No threats, third-party disclosure, or request for payment credentials.

customer_visible: 本人已经发起付款及回执
已收到的模拟电话或站内通知
visits.utterance: 我想确认这期付款现在入账了吗？之前的提醒还需要处理吗？

intake: Read the authoritative installment status and contact preferences.
poll: At the D2 follow-up, observe the past_due status, make the permitted reminder and schedule a payment check for D3 11:15.
Confirm E2 during the D3 follow-up before notifying the customer and closing.
push: On E1 at 08:30, retain the pending 09:00 follow-up and defer voice contact.
On E2, verify paid status, deliver a secure-inbox settlement notice, cancel the redundant D3 follow-up and close.
outreach: Verify opt-in, past_due status and prior attempts before starting the D2 voice contact.
Verify identity before sharing the reminder; record successful delivery and agree no unsupported debit or timing promise.
After payment clears, use the opted-in secure inbox and make no delinquency voice call.
conditional_revisit: Reuse the ticket, verify the current clearing status, and give the verified result without initiating any payment on the user's behalf.

evidence: successful D2 voice reminder before E2 and V1
all attempts counted across the previous 24 hours
identity verification before any account detail
customer-visible voice transcript complies with synthetic content rule

negative_examples.action: Wait until the customer follows up; E2 eventually applies without any Agent action.
Start the call before 09:00, repeat an unanswered attempt inside 24 hours, or call after payment posts.
Threaten the customer or ask for payment credentials.

runtime_blockers: Case intake wake and condition evaluation against servicing and notice state.
Installment, payment-clearing and contact preference tools such as read_installment, read_payment_status and read_contact_preferences.
Outbound voice attempts, identity and delivery records plus a secure-inbox notification tool.
Credit evaluator for the specified outcome, contact rules and process evidence.
